_note: The skin. Every player-visible string lives here; mechanics live in tiles.json / cards.json / items.json and never change. Swapping this file re-themes the whole game. Written clean-room: these names and lines are our own, not the original's.
title: Grave Errand
tagline: Find the relic. Bury it in the family plot. Beat the clock to midnight — alone.

cardFlavour._note: One line per card per hour band, keyed by card id then hour. Read alongside the matching entry in cards.json — the line describes what that band's outcome feels like, and carries no mechanics of its own.

1.10: Something glints under a dust sheet.
1.11: Six of them pour in from the dark.

2.9: Four shapes straighten up in the corners.
2.10: A frame drops off the wall, and the glass finds you.
2.11: A cupboard hangs open, half emptied already.

3.9: A toolbox sits where someone dropped it.
3.10: Four of them crowd into the doorway.
3.11: You misjudge a step in the dark.

4.9: Four come in over the windowsill.
4.10: Cold hands brush past before you can turn.
4.11: Six press through the gap at once.

5.9: Somebody left their kit behind in a hurry.
5.10: Five of them come at the sound of you.
5.11: The air in here bites, and takes your breath with it.

6.9: No trap here but bad footing. It still hurts.
6.10: Four heads turn toward you together.
6.11: Silence, and the smell of old rain.

7.9: A door swings open on its own. Nothing behind it.
7.10: Clean water, and a moment long enough to drink it.
7.11: Four step out of the shadow along the wall.

8.9: You find a chair, and your breath, at the same time.
8.10: A drawer stands open with something still in it.
8.11: Four of them were already waiting.

9.10: Dust, and the sound of your own steps.
9.11: Five block the way you came in.
